lessons_note: Corpus-without-consumer anti-pattern: a 'calibration corpus' sprint must wire the corpus into an automated check, not just generate it — here golden-set.json is created but no code reads it, so the headline 'drift probe' degrades to a self-contained arithmetic linter. A named deliverable that no code path consumes is an incomplete acceptance criterion, not a stylistic nit. Also: silently re-scoping a required report type in a code comment instead of backpropagating to the Sprint Contract violates 기준 역전파 원칙.
